status: experimental, review only; not integrated or device tested
supported: LOW_LATENCY requests OH FAST and verifies reported latency mode; NONE requests NORMAL
Android GAME+MUSIC, MEDIA+MUSIC and MEDIA+MOVIE map to OH GAME, MUSIC and MOVIE
renderer error callback mapped to AAudio errors; service death maps to disconnected
unsupported: other usage/content combinations; OH has no independent content type
limitations: CRI AAudio selection and dlsym call sites unverified
callback STOP requests stop asynchronously on worker
closed stream tombstone intentionally retained because SDK release callback quiescence is undocumented; memory grows per close
caller must serialize close with other API calls
timestamp and frame semantics require device validation
immutable format, sample rate, channel count and direction getters work in data callback; dynamic renderer queries and control operations reject callback thread
unsupported builder setters cause open to fail
STOP remains latched until asynchronous stop completes
thread creation and guest C++ exceptions are contained
OH latency mode is a reported mode, not measured latency or proof of fast playback
error mapping is approximate except explicit service death; callback delivery and lifecycle need device testing
57 exported symbols do not imply 57 supported operations

implemented: wait for state change by polling actual renderer state with timeout
query_policy.reason: Boolean ABI has no error value; OH renderer configuration does not establish equivalent Android privacy or spatialization semantics. FrameSizeInCallback is not a hardware burst. OH GetLatencyMode does not prove Android performance mode. FramesRead for Android output is advanced by endpoint, not zero.
